rules.label: Core sustainability corpus: climate/environment/circular-economy
rules.rationale: MIXED — see mechanismQuestion in this same rule's companion note below the rule table; largely retained on the strength of its narrower sub-matches (greenhouse-gas-emissions reduction, renewable energy, waste shipment, batteries) which do satisfy STANDARDS for freight fuels/vehicles/logistics-supply-chain waste movement, while its broadest sub-matches (generic 'climate change', ecodesign, CSRD, sustainable-finance taxonomy) are flagged separately as a mechanism-re-audit question — see the report.
rules.open_question: QUESTION (mechanism re-audit 2026-08-31, MIXED rule — largest ON_VERTICAL bucket, 106 rows): this rule's five sub-phrases are not uniformly freight-mechanism-satisfying. 'greenhouse gas emissions reduction', 'renewable energy directive', and 'waste shipment regulation' plausibly satisfy STANDARDS for freight fuels/logistics-supply-chain waste movement. But 'climate change' (generic), 'ecodesign' (general product energy-efficiency labelling, e.g. appliances), 'corporate sustainability reporting/CSRD' (general corporate ESG-disclosure law applying to all large companies, not freight-specific), and 'sustainable finance taxonomy' (an investment-classification system) satisfy no prong on a strict freight-mechanism reading — this is the single largest instance of the instrument-family-not-mechanism defect this wave exists to fix. Kept on_vertical in full (never silently flipped, and the rule's match logic cannot be split without becoming five separate rules); flagged prominently for operator review — a follow-up wave should split this rule along its five sub-phrases so each can be independently mechanism-tested.
rules.ruling: ADR-020 sustainability-first scope, edge zones ruled in

rules.ruling: ADR-020 customs-procedure and transport-administration out of scope, screen round 2

rules.name: vehicle_safety_standard_us
rules.pattern: federal motor vehicle safety standards|ads equipped vehicle safety|electronic logging device|bus testing program
rules.label: Denylist: US federal motor vehicle safety/technical standards (vehicle-administration, not a sustainability rule)
rules.rationale: US FMVSS vehicle-safety standards (crashworthiness, electronic logging devices, ADS safety-transparency programs) address occupant/operational safety, not carbon or environmental intensity.
rules.ruling: ADR-020 customs-procedure and transport-administration out of scope, screen round 2

rules.name: financial_services_administration_us
rules.pattern: swap dealers|uncleared swaps|stablecoin|anti money laundering|resolution submissions|depository institutions|form x.?17a.?5|margin requirements
rules.label: Denylist: US financial-services administration (banking/derivatives/AML — no sustainability/freight nexus)
rules.rationale: US financial-services administration (swap dealer margin rules, stablecoin issuer requirements, AML, depository-institution resolution planning) has no freight or environmental-intensity content.
rules.ruling: ADR-020 customs-procedure and transport-administration out of scope, screen round 2

rules.name: ses_route_charging_zone_administration
rules.pattern: unit rates? for charging zones?|compliance of.*charging zone|implementing regulation \(eu\) no 391\/2013
rules.label: Denylist: Single European Sky air-navigation route-charging (unit-rate) administration
rules.rationale: PRICES + STANDARDS: SES route-charging unit-rate compliance decisions administer the pricing side of the same environmental-KPA performance-target apparatus as ses_performance_plan_administration — airspace-use pricing tied to the environmental performance scheme, applicable to air-cargo tonne-km.
rules.ruling: FLIP: operator ruling 2026-08-31

rules.name: road_transport_occupation_access_administration
rules.pattern: admission to the occupations? of road|access to the occupation of carrier
rules.label: Denylist: admission-to-the-occupation road/waterway-transport-operator market-access administration
rules.rationale: Admission-to-the-occupation rules for road/waterway carriers are professional/market-access licensing administration (financial standing, good repute, professional competence) — not an environmental standard on the vehicle, vessel, or movement.
rules.ruling: ADR-020 customs-procedure and transport-administration out of scope, screen round 2

rules.name: goods_vehicle_operator_licensing
rules.pattern: goods vehicles? \(licensing of operators\)
rules.label: Denylist: goods-vehicle operator licensing administration
rules.rationale: UK goods-vehicle operator-licensing amendment/exemption regulations are administrative licensing-scheme procedure — the sampled population carries no environmental-fitness content, only procedural amendment/exemption/temporary-use text.
rules.ruling: ADR-020 customs-procedure and transport-administration out of scope, screen round 2

rules.name: vehicle_roadworthiness_testing
rules.pattern: motor vehicles? \(tests\)|goods vehicles? \(tests\)
rules.label: Denylist: vehicle roadworthiness testing (MOT-style) administration
rules.rationale: UK MOT-style roadworthiness-testing amendment regulations govern the TEST SCHEME procedurally (what tests exist, how administered) — the sampled titles are bare 'Amendment Regulations' with no emission-limit content; the substantive emission standards vehicles are tested against live elsewhere in this ruleset (co2_emission_standards, unece_vehicle_technical_regulation's noise/exhaust subset).
rules.ruling: ADR-020 customs-procedure and transport-administration out of scope, screen round 2

rules.name: transport_statistical_returns_administration
rules.pattern: statistical returns in respect of (?:the )?carriage
rules.label: Denylist: transport statistical-returns reporting administration (Eurostat data collection, not a sustainability rule)
rules.rationale: Statistical-returns reporting on carriage of goods/passengers (Eurostat data collection) describes traffic volumes after the fact — it does not itself price, cap, standard, verify, or enable environmental intensity; it is background statistics collection, not a decarbonization-enabling mechanism.
rules.ruling: ADR-020 customs-procedure and transport-administration out of scope, screen round 2

rules.name: heavy_goods_vehicle_charging_administration
rules.pattern: charging of heavy goods vehicles for the use of certain infrastructure
rules.label: Denylist: heavy-goods-vehicle infrastructure-charging/vehicle-tax administration
rules.rationale: PRICES: the Eurovignette Directive (1999/62/EC and successors) modulates HGV infrastructure-charging tariffs and vehicle tax by the vehicle's CO2 emission class and Euro emission standard — a direct price signal on freight-vehicle environmental intensity, not a flat administrative toll.
rules.ruling: FLIP: operator ruling 2026-08-31

rules.name: single_electronic_reporting_format_taxonomy
rules.pattern: taxonomy.*single electronic reporting format|single electronic reporting format
rules.label: Denylist: ESEF single electronic reporting format (general corporate financial-reporting taxonomy, not sustainability-specific)
rules.rationale: ESEF is a general corporate financial-reporting XBRL taxonomy applicable to all large issuers — a financial-disclosure-format standard, not a carbon/environmental-intensity mechanism, and not freight-specific.
rules.ruling: ADR-020 customs-procedure and transport-administration out of scope, screen round 2

rules.name: transit_ecopoints_bilateral_agreement
rules.pattern: system of ecopoints
rules.label: Denylist: Austria transit-ecopoints bilateral trade agreements (transport-administration)
rules.rationale: CAPS: Austria/Switzerland Alpine transit-ecopoint systems cap the volume of heavy-goods-vehicle transit crossings by the vehicle's engine emission standard on environmentally sensitive corridors — a direct cap on freight-vehicle environmental intensity, not merely a bilateral trade formality.
rules.ruling: FLIP: operator ruling 2026-08-31

rules.name: road_vehicle_weight_dimensions_administration
rules.pattern: road vehicles \(authorised weight\)
rules.label: Allowlist (FLIP, operator ruling 2026-09-02): road-vehicle authorised-weight (weights and dimensions) instruments
rules.rationale: Weights-and-dimensions instruments are the lever through which zero-emission and alternatively-fuelled heavy vehicles receive their additional-mass allowance and longer-cab aerodynamics; a road-vehicle authorised-weight amendment is a freight-decarbonisation instrument, not only an infrastructure-protection ceiling.
rules.ruling: FLIP: operator ruling 2026-09-02: weights and dimensions carry the zero-emission-truck allowance

rules.name: vehicle_type_approval_market_surveillance
rules.pattern: approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles
rules.label: Denylist: vehicle type-approval and market-surveillance administration, broader than round-1's hyphenated 'type-approval' match
rules.rationale: Regulation (EU) 2018/858 is the umbrella type-approval/market-surveillance FRAMEWORK regulation — the administrative machinery through which many OTHER substantive standards (including but not limited to emissions) are enforced; the framework regulation itself is procedural, kept off for the same reason as denylist_vehicle_type_approval_correction (the substantive emission standard lives in co2_emission_standards).
rules.ruling: ADR-020 customs-procedure and transport-administration out of scope, screen round 2
